PR title:
for #1287: allow bool type with bool flags

PR body:
Small fix for when specifying boolean flag and type. 

fixes #1287

Gold patch (use only to infer the symptom; do not quote or describe the fix):

+    ``type=bool``. :issue:`1287`
 
 
 Version 7.0

message.content: When using a boolean flag with `type=bool` explicitly specified, a `TypeError` is raised instead of the flag being handled correctly as a boolean flag.
